description: Read a public playlist of at most 200 source items from its full HTTPS URL and create a 24-hour Soundiiz import link. Supported sources: Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, YouTube, YouTube Music, Qobuz, TIDAL and public Soundiiz playlists. Private playlists and short links are unsupported. Preserve a requested destination and omit it otherwise. Show warnings, the exact shareUrl including query parameters, and expiry. The user reviews the tracks and connects the destination to complete the transfer in Soundiiz. No music-service password or user token is needed.

country.description: Optional two-letter catalog country for a TIDAL source, default US. Apple Music uses the storefront in its URL.

destination.description: Include only when the user requests a platform. Use its documented Soundiiz API corename; otherwise omit this field.

name: createSoundiizImportLinkFromUrl

expiresAt.description: Import expiry as a Unix timestamp in seconds (UTC).

sourceItems.description: Source item count before filtering; it can exceed nbTracks.

warnings.description: Show any warnings about source items excluded from the import.

httpStatus.description: HTTP status associated with this tool error.

retryAfter.description: Wait at least this many seconds before retrying.

title: Create a Soundiiz import link from a public playlist URL
